hints.title: Suffix Sum Transformation
hints.text: The total stones remaining from index i onward is suffix_sum[i]. A player aims to maximize their stones by minimizing the opponent answer.

hints.title: State Representation
hints.text: Define subproblem state by the current pile index i and current multiplier M. Candidate choices allow taking X piles where 1 <= X <= 2 * M.

hints.title: Transition Relation
hints.text: Score at state (i, M) is suffix_sum[i] minus the minimum over valid X of state (i + X, max(M, X)).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive game tree exploration yields exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizing states indexed by (i, M) limits unique subproblems to N * N.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize minimax game theory and formulate suffix sum complementary transitions.
complexity.notes: Initial parameters are i = 0 and M = 1.
